public_rationale: Marcus calls two-to-three-year timelines implausible; he does not say AGI will certainly fail to arrive within them. The selected wording gives no probability threshold or other reproducible plausibility test. Grading it by whether AGI appears by 2027–2028 would replace his judgment with a stronger forecast. The appropriate result is not_adjudicable, rather than an unresolved categorical prediction.
limitations: This does not endorse or reject Marcus's skepticism.
The surrounding factual claims about model capabilities would require separate assessments.
